subject.title: acpx plugin dependencies missing from Nix derivation — causes EACCES

question: Should ACPX become an officially supported nix-openclaw runtime plugin despite the earlier not-planned decision?
rationale: The immutable-store failure is well described, but packaging and continuously validating ACPX changes the repository's supported plugin set and therefore requires explicit ownership rather than a purely mechanical repair.

options.title: Support ACPX declaratively
options.body: Add ACPX only after its complete runtime dependency graph can be reproduced and validated without network access or immutable-store writes.

options.title: Keep ACPX unsupported
options.body: Reject ACPX configuration early and explain the upstream dependency-publication requirement instead of allowing runtime installation attempts.

recommendation.title: Support ACPX declaratively
recommendation.body: Add ACPX only after its complete runtime dependency graph can be reproduced and validated without network access or immutable-store writes.

likelyOwner.reason: They were explicitly brought into this issue and are an official repository maintainer listed by policy.
